source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 4 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 6.1 The system will reset immediately. 6.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Fatal Error - VIN Bulk Input Only: inject the DDR PMIC Fatal Error - VIN Bulk Input Only via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_Fatal_Error_-_VIN_Bulk_Input_Only; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

disposition_reason: VIN is upstream of the PMIC switch rails; a VIN fault can make downstream symptoms resemble SWA-SWD failures. The test therefore needs VIN-specific status plus simultaneous downstream telemetry to prove the selected domain. Repeating a hard-coded dimm0 tuple cannot cover physical PMICs, and each comparator direction requires separate electrical limits and full memory recovery. test_case.test_name: Fatal Error - VIN Bulk Input Only — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject the PMIC VIN bulk-input-only fatal condition for each required DIMM and voltage comparator, verify an immediate reset and fresh VIN-input evidence, then confirm the input supply, downstream rails and memory recover safely.
required_package: PMIC documentation proving railtype4 is VIN Bulk Input Only and defining voltagetype0/1 comparators
Per-DIMM socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, PMIC part/address and VIN source topology
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB access and expected VIN status response
Vendor-correct command continuation and complete tuple matrix
VIN nominal range, downstream rail expectations, current/temperature limits and abort thresholds
Fresh VIN PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL evidence, reset/boot/training deadlines, memory recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map each DIMM/PMIC and its input supply; prove railtype4 and voltagetype encoding; identify BMC/platform I2C controller/address; record VIN and downstream-rail baseline; inject one tuple under OOB and electrical monitoring; correlate VIN-specific status and persistent logs; validate reset, training and memory; restore PMIC/I2C settings before another target.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.

safety_gate: Dedicated instrumented SUT with independent console and VIN/downstream rail telemetry
Verify physical input-source-to-PMIC mapping and preserve baseline status/SPD
Inject one comparator on one DIMM once with full restoration gate
Abort on wrong input status, unsafe VIN/downstream rail reading, unexpected reset, boot/training failure, DIMM loss or management-bus failure
No automatic target traversal; restore PMIC mode/recovery, SPD ownership, telemetry polling, I2C enables and HDT
expected_evidence: VIN/railtype4/voltagetype register map and physical input-to-PMIC/DIMM/I2C topology
Pinned tool/spec and raw VIN/downstream rail, status, SPD and BIOS baseline

test_case.recovery: Use the project-required BMC/platform I2C path, not a host listing, to identify PMIC address/status. Ensure the monitoring method can distinguish VIN loss from a downstream SWA-SWD event.

source_conflict.reason: All DIMMs and voltage types0/1 are required, but only fixed 0:0:3/dimm0/voltagetype0 is supplied; command continuation and expansion are undefined. Railtype4 and input-only/comparator semantics, I2C ownership and electrical criteria are unproven.
